svg.title: SnapVault undo for AI agents
svg.desc: Timeline of a real agent session. SnapVault records checkpoint 5920759dba58 when the session starts. The agent runs rm photos.txt from a shell, with no tool call. The timer records checkpoint e20cc8f4c64c. The agent calls restore and photos.txt comes back from the first checkpoint. The checkpoint store sits outside the folder. The agent gets four tools: checkpoint, list_checkpoints, diff, restore.
